description: Two-portal square arena. Like an I-corridor in topology (one entry on the north, one on the south, no branches) but the middle is a wide open square floor — room for combat encounters. The straight-line route between the portals runs through the center.

portals.north: spawn_north at (0.02, -23.53) — gate on the north (low-Z) end
portals.south: spawn_south at (-0.09, 23.50) — gate on the south (high-Z) end

anchors.description: center of the square arena — dispatch anchor (matches wp_1780257706152_l5q4qb)

traversalNotes: Straight-line traversal: the autopilot can walk directly between spawn_north and spawn_south through the center of the arena.

DISPATCH RULE (same as I-corridors): any in-cell objective routes through arena_center (l5q4qb). Walk current_gate → arena_center → objective → arena_center → next_gate. This keeps movement axis-aligned and avoids drifting into walls when the player chases enemies around the arena.

The wide center floor is for combat — expect kill_all actions to spawn enemies anywhere in the room. The dispatch rule still applies after combat: pick the route back to arena_center before heading to the exit gate.
